title: Tarragona Amphitheatre
scope: The current Tarragona Roman amphitheatre ruins, including the surviving seaward and western seating banks, two axial access areas, excavated passages and the standing remains of Santa Maria del Miracle on the arena floor.
limitations: The present visible ruin is modeled. The building remains measured and interpreted at the scale of the surviving complex, with individual broken stones, stair breaks and excavated channel depths represented approximately.
The modern site paths, handrails, structural conservation barriers and nearby buildings are outside this model except for the main walking levels needed to read the ruin.
